explanation: His poster for her play Gismonda, posted in Paris in January 1895, made him famous almost overnight, and Bernhardt signed him to a six-year contract. Mucha was born in Moravia, in modern Czechia.

claims.text: Alphonse Mucha's posters of Sarah Bernhardt helped define the Art Nouveau style.
Gustav Klimt, Egon Schiele and Aubrey Beardsley did not make the celebrated Art Nouveau posters of Sarah Bernhardt.
Mucha's poster for Sarah Bernhardt's play Gismonda appeared in Paris in January 1895 and made him famous.
Sarah Bernhardt signed Mucha to a six-year contract.
Alphonse Mucha was born in Moravia, in modern Czechia.
